crossRefs.note: “I have loved you,” says Yahweh. Yet you say, “How have you loved us?” “Wasn’t Esau Jacob’s brother?” says Yahweh, “Yet…
but Esau I hated, and made his mountains a desolation, and gave his heritage to the jackals of the wilderness.”
Yahweh saw that Leah was hated, and he opened her womb, but Rachel was barren.
She conceived again, and bore a son, and said, “Because Yahweh has heard that I am hated, he has therefore given me…
If a man has two wives, the one beloved and the other hated, and they have borne him children, both the beloved and the…
One who spares the rod hates his son, but one who loves him is careful to discipline him.
He who loves father or mother more than me is not worthy of me; and he who loves son or daughter more than me isn’t…
“If anyone comes to me, and doesn’t disregard his own father, mother, wife, children, brothers, and sisters, yes, and…
He who loves his life will lose it. He who hates his life in this world will keep it to eternal life.

people.name: Esau
people.line: Isaac's firstborn son; sold birthright to Jacob; became Edom.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Even as it is written, “Jacob I loved, but Esau I hated.”
translations.bsb: So it is written: “Jacob I loved, but Esau I hated.”
translations.kjv: As it is written, Jacob have I loved, but Esau have I hated.
translations.asv: Even as it is written, Jacob I loved, but Esau I hated.
